title: I'M LOOKING FOR PEOPLE TO PLAYTEST MY GAME
author: rapidforge_games
selftext:
Hey everyone, I’m looking for playtesters for my multiplayer card game, Digital Clash! 

​The concept is simple: you use number and operator cards to solve equations and outsmart your opponents. I also updated the tutorial so it's not gonna be hard understanding the game

​It features 1v1, 3-4 player free-for-alls, and team modes, alongside daily rewards and unlockable skins.

​I’d love for you to play a few matches and give me some brutally honest feedback. Tell me what’s fun, confusing, broken, or just boring!

​You can play it here: https://nkakoleng.itch.io/digital-clash

​Any feedback will help a ton
